statement_text: Second-prime-window cross-term structure: in the window (1/2 log3, log2), with both primes p=2,3 in the single-hop regime, the cross-prime term F_{ij}(tau_2,tau_3) = <C_{tau_3,1} P_j, C_{tau_2,1} P_i> is a REAL, NONZERO contribution to the two-prime Schur second moment S^{(2)} = c_2^2 E(tau_2) + c_3^2 E(tau_3) + c_2 c_3 (F_ij + F_ji). Concretely, Delta C = C_full - C_cross_off = -3 c_2 c_3 (F_ij + F_ji) is nonzero at Arb grade (S4 metric A). This is the genuine new structure the first window does not contain (method-range extension). This is a finite-scale structural statement, bounded to L < log2, and does NOT claim positive-definiteness of the second window (at the left end L=11/20 the odd sector is certifiably negative and the even sector straddles zero) and does NOT imply RH.
